context:
Goal: main green again, and the queued batches unblocked.
Problem (risk): main has been red since 19:53 CST on the Windows merge test shards; the fix batch's own CI run is all green, but the harness's permission layer refused the batch runner's merge as "undermining oversight", so it needs your word.
Based on (read): runner 10's message at 23:19 CST, relayed by the coordinator at 23:20 CST; batch PR #3080 (batch 119, holding #3052, the Windows test-scope fix, and #2849, the Mac mail un-hold) passed every job on run 43366798173.
Based on (ruling): your Cockpit pick 178 a (2026-11-03 22:31 CST): Claude may type the merge tool's red-main reason flag, with a logged reason, only for the batch that carries the fix.
Departs from: main refuses every batch merge while main is red — this one fix batch merges onto red main, with its reason in the merge commit.
Why yours: the harness refused the act, so only your yes lets it run.
home: decision no-merge-onto-red-main; standing grant Relayed yes

options.gain: Main can turn green on the next push run (the Windows merge shards run only on a push, so only the merge can prove the fix), and the queued batches (the #2992 fix-chain PR first) and every lane waiting on main move again.
options.how: Type this line in runner 10's session, where the harness asks you: "Yes: merge #3080 at head 888481daacbec0d89d5d0b4957650a256c3783e0 with --base-red-ok, because it carries #3052, the fix for main's red push run 43348145389." Runner 10 then merges with the merge tool, under every other merge check.
options.label: Yes, merge batch 119 now (recommended)
options.lose: If the fix does not cure Windows, main stays red one more run; a fix lane starts at once.

options.gain: Nothing lands on a red main.
options.label: No, wait
options.lose: Main stays red and every batch stays blocked, since only a batch carrying the fix can turn it green.

title: May batch 119, which carries the fix for red main, merge now?
why: The harness refused the merge, so it needs your word.
